title: draws
description: The engine's action list in frame order: markers and calls, with the engine's own event ids (`probe` lists the same ids, and `SetFrameEvent` takes them). The structured file's chunk numbering is *not* used here (REFERENCE §9): the two spaces are different, and the chunk-derived one is not an id the engine answers to.

depth.description: how deep in the marker nest

call.description: a draw/dispatch/copy rather than a marker

name.description: the marker's custom name, or the call's own name

path.description: the markers this row sits inside, `A > B`, empty at the root

truncated.description: present only when the action tree was deeper than the recursion limit
